title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening Environmental and Resource Adjudication Work to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantee for Promoting Ecological Civilization Construction
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Comprehensively Strengthening Environmental Resources Adjudication to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantee for Promoting Ecological Civilization Construction

Fa Fa [2014] No. 11

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee, and the important speeches of General Secretary Xi Jinping, give full play to the trial function of the people's courts, and provide strong judicial guarantee for promoting ecological civilization construction, the following opinions are hereby put forward on comprehensively strengthening the environmental resources adjudication work of the people's courts.

I. The Great Significance of Comprehensively Strengthening Environmental Resources Adjudication in the New Situation

1. Comprehensively strengthening environmental resources adjudication is an inevitable requirement for implementing the central decision and promoting ecological civilization construction. At present, China is faced with a severe situation of tightening resource constraints, serious environmental pollution, and degrading ecosystems, which has already affected the life and health of the people and the sustainable development of the economy and society. In order to reverse the trend of ecological environmental deterioration from the source, build a beautiful China, and achieve the sustainable development of the Chinese nation, the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China incorporated ecological civilization construction into the five-in-one overall layout of the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Comprehensively Deepening Reforms," adopted at the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee, further pointed out that to build an ecological civilization, it is necessary to establish a systematic and complete system of ecological civilization institutions and use institutions to protect the ecological environment. General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasized that stepping into a new era of ecological civilization and building a beautiful China is an important part of the Chinese Dream of realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Facing the new situation and tasks, people's courts at all levels must conscientiously study the central government's new ideas and new conclusions on strengthening ecological civilization construction, unify ideological understanding, comprehensively strengthen environmental resources adjudication, use legal means to sanction illegal acts such as polluting the environment and damaging ecosystems, effectively ensure the implementation of natural resource and environmental protection systems, protect the life and health of the people, promote social harmony and stability, and promote sustainable economic and social development.

2. Comprehensively strengthening environmental resources adjudication is an inevitable requirement for responding to the people's new expectations for environmental resources justice and safeguarding the people's environmental resources rights and interests. General Secretary Xi Jinping has put forward a series of new ideas and new requirements, such as "mountains, rivers, forests, farmlands, and lakes are a community of life," "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets," and "the people's aspiration for a better life is our goal of struggle." With rapid economic development and rising material living standards, the environmental resources awareness of the general public is gradually increasing, the demand for good ecological environments and high-quality ecological products such as clean water, fresh air, and safe food is becoming more urgent, and the call for participation in environmental resources protection is also growing louder. People's courts at all levels must actively respond to the people's new expectations and new requirements for environmental resources justice, and by lawfully adjudicating environmental resources cases, effectively safeguard the public's environmental resources rights and interests, providing solid judicial guarantees for the Chinese nation and future generations to forever enjoy a beautiful and livable living space and an ecologically sound landscape.

3. Comprehensively strengthening environmental resources adjudication is an inevitable requirement for unifying the adjudication standards and ensuring the correct implementation of environmental resources laws. The Civil Procedure Law establishes the environmental public interest litigation system. The revised Environmental Protection Law greatly strengthens the protection of the ecological environment, further defines the scope of plaintiffs in environmental public interest litigation, and together with other environmental resources protection laws, forms a relatively complete legal system for environmental resources protection, becoming a powerful legal weapon for preventing and punishing acts of polluting the environment and damaging ecosystems. People's courts at all levels must conscientiously study and implement environmental resources laws, deeply study the rules of environmental resources adjudication, update the judicial concepts of environmental resources, standardize the procedures of environmental resources adjudication, unify the adjudication standards, and through high-quality and efficient case adjudication and enforcement, promote and ensure the comprehensive and correct implementation of environmental resources laws.

II. Guiding Ideology, Basic Principles, and Objectives and Tasks of Environmental Resources Adjudication

4. Guiding ideology. Guided by the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee, conscientiously study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches, deeply implement the central government's major arrangements for comprehensively deepening reform, closely focus on the goal of "letting the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," firmly adhere to the main line of judicial for the people and fair justice, effectively implement the basic national policy of resource conservation and environmental protection, pay more attention to and comprehensively strengthen environmental resources adjudication, lawfully adjudicate environmental resources protection cases, actively promote the study of judicial theory and systems of environmental resources, and promote the improvement of the strictest source protection system, damage compensation system, and accountability system, so as to provide strong judicial guarantees for promoting ecological civilization construction, enhancing the people's well-being, and building a beautiful China.

5. Basic principles. First, adhere to protection in accordance with the law. Fulfill the duties of judicial protection of environmental resources in accordance with the provisions of laws and administrative regulations, and effectively safeguard the people's environmental resources rights and interests. Pay attention to strengthening communication with procuratorial organs, public security organs, and administrative law enforcement departments for environmental resources protection, with each performing its own duties, division of labor, and coordinated action to jointly reverse the trend of ecological environmental deterioration. Second, adhere to protection priority. Actively innovate trial mechanisms and enforcement measures, and in accordance with the requirement of giving priority to environmental resources protection, increase the punishment of acts that pollute the environment and damage resources. Third, adhere to focusing on prevention. Actively adopt judicial measures in the case adjudication process to prevent and reduce environmental damage and resource destruction, and reduce the possibility and degree of environmental risks through preventive measures in advance. Fourth, adhere to the principle that the polluter bears the responsibility. Implement the provisions on comprehensive compensation, explore the establishment of systems such as environmental restoration and punitive damages, and seriously pursue the legal liability of violators in accordance with the law.

6. Objectives and tasks. Judicial remedies for environmental resources disputes are unimpeded; the systems of source protection, damage compensation, and accountability for environmental resources are implemented; systems such as environmental public interest litigation and jurisdiction over environmental resources cases are continuously improved; the judicial protection systems for environmental resources, including criminal, civil, administrative, and enforcement, are more complete; the professional level and judicial ability of the environmental resources judge team are significantly improved; environmental resources adjudication work is comprehensively strengthened, and its functional role is fully exerted.

III. Give Full Play to the Functions of Environmental Resources Adjudication

7. Severely punish crimes of polluting the environment and destroying resources in accordance with the law. Increase the intensity of adjudication of criminal cases involving environmental resources protection, and in accordance with the law, severely punish illegal and criminal acts that pollute the environment and destroy resources, such as polluting the environment, indiscriminate logging, indiscriminate hunting of wild animals, indiscriminate mining of mineral resources, illegal occupation of agricultural land, production and discharge of pollutants, illegal disposal of imported solid waste, and unauthorized import of solid waste. Severely punish crimes of dereliction of duty in environmental supervision. For crimes of throwing dangerous substances that cause serious consequences of environmental pollution, crimes of major safety accidents, and cases involving a large number of victims, actively cooperate with relevant departments to handle the aftermath and maximize the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of the people.

8. Lawfully adjudicate civil cases concerning environmental resources. Unblock channels for judicial remedies, improve judicial convenience measures, and promptly accept civil cases concerning environmental resources protection in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate property rights, contract, and tort cases related to environmental resources protection, such as those involving land, minerals, grasslands, forests, fisheries, water, electricity, gas, heat, and oceans, with special emphasis on strengthening the adjudication of environmental tort cases involving contaminated soil and water sources. For cases involving the transfer of shares, contracting, joint operation, leasing, and mortgage of mining rights, forestry rights, and other natural resource rights, comprehensively consider the protection of the ecological environment and natural resources as important factors in the judgment. Give full play to the preventive and damage-reducing roles of preservation and provisional execution measures; promptly accept, quickly review, lawfully rule, and immediately execute applications for preservation and provisional execution. Lawfully determine the burden of proof of the parties; for disputes arising from environmental pollution and ecological damage, the plaintiff shall bear the burden of proving the existence of the pollution act and the damage, and submit preliminary evidence of a possible causal relationship between the pollution act and the damage; the defendant shall bear the burden of proving the circumstances under which it is not liable or the liability is mitigated as provided by law, and that there is no causal relationship between its act and the damage.

9. Lawfully adjudicate administrative cases concerning environmental resources. Lawfully accept administrative cases concerning environmental resources, fully protect the litigant rights of the parties. In the adjudication of cases, not only shall the legality of the administrative agency's enforcement procedures be reviewed procedurally, but also whether administrative permits, administrative penalties, and other acts comply with legal standards shall be reviewed substantively, with special emphasis on strengthening the adjudication of cases concerning administrative agencies' failure to perform their duties of investigating and punishing violations of environmental resources protection laws and regulations, urging administrative agencies to perform their duties in accordance with the law. Cautiously apply mediation to conclude cases, and maximize the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of the administrative counterpart and the environmental health and safety of the public. Properly adjudicate administrative cases concerning disputes over mountain and forest rights and rights confirmation, promote the improvement of the property rights system for natural resources assets, and strengthen the protection of natural resources such as land, minerals, water sources, and forests. Appropriately handle the relationship between civil litigation and administrative litigation arising from the same environmental resources dispute, avoiding contradictory findings by different adjudication organizations on the same administrative act. Actively explore the consolidated adjudication of environmental administrative litigation and civil litigation, and continuously improve the evidence rules and legal application rules for environmental administrative litigation.

10. Strengthen the enforcement of environmental resources cases. Actively seek the support and cooperation of administrative law enforcement departments for environmental resources protection during the enforcement process to ensure that the administrative and civil liabilities to be borne by the person subject to enforcement are fully implemented. Appropriately adopt methods such as setting a deadline for performance and performance by proxy to achieve the purpose of ecological restoration. Innovate enforcement methods, explore the establishment of a follow-up visit system for enforcement of environmental resources protection cases, and closely monitor whether the responsible party's pollution control, remediation measures, and ecological restoration after the judgment are implemented. Lawfully review non-litigation administrative cases concerning environmental resources; for administrative agencies applying to the people's court for compulsory enforcement of effective administrative punishment decisions in accordance with the law, if the people's court, after review, rules to allow compulsory enforcement, it shall promptly organize the implementation of the compulsory enforcement.

IV. Vigorously Promote Environmental Civil Public Interest Litigation

11. Fully protect the environmental civil public interest litigation rights of the agencies and relevant organizations provided by law. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law, the Environmental Protection Law, and the Marine Environmental Protection Law, fully protect the litigation rights of the plaintiff in environmental public interest litigation and promptly accept qualified public interest litigation. For public interest litigation initiated by the marine environmental supervision and management department and other agencies that have the duty to supervise, manage, and protect the environmental public interest, as well as public interest litigation initiated by social organizations that meet the requirements of Article 58 of the Environmental Protection Law, it shall be accepted in accordance with the law. Where the same act of polluting the environment or damaging the ecosystem harms both the public interest and the civil rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations, the initiation of public interest litigation by relevant agencies and organizations shall not affect the victim's separate initiation of civil litigation.

12. Lawfully determine the competent court for environmental civil public interest litigation. Environmental public interest litigation shall generally be under the jurisdiction of the intermediate people's court of the place where the tort occurred or where the defendant is domiciled. Where the same plaintiff or different plaintiffs initiate environmental public interest litigation against the same act separately in two or more people's courts that have jurisdiction, the people's court that first accepts the case shall have jurisdiction. The common higher people's court may also designate one of the courts with jurisdiction for centralized jurisdiction.

13. Explore and improve the trial procedures for environmental civil public interest litigation. Explore the establishment of a communication and coordination mechanism for case filing, and promptly notify the administrative law enforcement department for environmental resources protection of the initiation of environmental public interest litigation. Explore the establishment of a system for announcing acceptance, and promptly announce the acceptance of environmental public interest litigation. For evidence concerning the public interest needed for the adjudication of the case that the plaintiff cannot obtain due to objective reasons, the court may ex officio collect it. For facts concerning the public interest that require appraisal and for which the plaintiff bears the burden of proof, the court may ex officio commission an appraisal. For the mediation agreement or application for withdrawal of the lawsuit by the parties, special attention shall be paid to reviewing whether it harms the national interest, the public interest, or the legitimate rights and interests of others. For effective judgments requiring compulsory enforcement measures, they may be transferred for enforcement in accordance with the law.

14. Lawfully determine the forms of liability and scope of compensation in environmental civil public interest litigation. When adjudicating environmental public interest litigation cases, the people's court may, upon the plaintiff's request, order the defendant to cease the infringement, remove the obstruction, eliminate the danger, return the property, restore the original state, or compensate for losses. Explore and study the scope of compensation in environmental public interest litigation and its relationship with the scope of compensation in private interest litigation. Where the plaintiff in environmental public interest litigation requests the defendant to compensate for costs of preventing damage or restoring the environment, losses caused to the ecological environment such as the destruction of natural resources, and reasonable litigation expenses such as attorney fees, investigation and evidence collection fees, and appraisal and assessment fees, it may be supported based on the circumstances of the case. Explore the establishment of a special fund for environmental public interest litigation, using environmental compensation funds exclusively for environmental restoration, ecological restoration, and maintenance of the public interest; where no such fund has been established, negotiate with administrative law enforcement departments for environmental resources protection, government financial departments, etc., to determine the method of delivery and use of environmental compensation funds.

15. Explore the establishment of a reasonable cost-bearing mechanism for litigation. Increase judicial assistance to plaintiffs in environmental public interest litigation. If agencies and relevant organizations provided by law apply to the people's court for deferment, reduction, or exemption of case acceptance fees or preservation application fees in accordance with the law, such applications may be granted. Reasonably determine the party bearing the litigation costs; where the plaintiff prevails, the reasonable attorney fees, investigation and evidence collection fees, and appraisal and assessment fees incurred by the plaintiff may be ordered to be borne by the defendant. Encourage the practice of paying the plaintiff's environmental public interest litigation costs from the environmental public interest litigation fund, giving full play to the positive role of environmental public interest litigation entities in maintaining the environmental public interest.

V. Orderly Promote the Reform of the Judicial System for Environmental Resources

16. Reasonably establish specialized adjudication organs for environmental resources. Based on the principles of "having genuine need, adapting to local conditions, and promoting step by step," establish specialized adjudication organs for environmental resources to provide organizational guarantees for strengthening environmental resources adjudication. Higher people's courts shall, in line with the idea of professional adjudication, rationalize institutional functions, reasonably allocate adjudication resources, and establish specialized adjudication organs for environmental resources. Intermediate people's courts shall, under the overall guidance of the higher people's court, reasonably establish environmental resources adjudication organs based on the volume of environmental resources adjudication business; where the number of cases is insufficient, an environmental resources collegial panel may be established. In individual basic people's courts with a high case volume, with the approval of the higher people's court, consideration may also be given to establishing environmental resources adjudication organs.

17. Actively explore the centralized adjudication of criminal, civil, and administrative cases concerning environmental resources. In light of local realities, actively explore the centralized adjudication of criminal, civil, and administrative cases concerning environmental resources by specialized environmental resources adjudication organs, optimize adjudication resources, and achieve professional adjudication of environmental resources cases. Where centralized adjudication of environmental resources cases has not been implemented, attention shall be paid to strengthening business coordination and communication among criminal, civil, and administrative adjudication organs.

18. Explore the establishment of a jurisdiction system for environmental resources cases that is appropriately separate from administrative divisions. Gradually change the current jurisdiction model that divides naturally formed ecosystems such as river basins by administrative divisions. Focus on proceeding from the natural attributes of environmental factors such as water and air, and in combination with the volume of environmental resources cases in various localities, explore the establishment of specialized adjudication organs for environmental resources across administrative divisions based on ecosystems such as river basins or ecological function zones, implementing centralized jurisdiction over environmental resources cases and effectively adjudicating cases such as pollution across administrative divisions.

VI. Establish and Improve the Working Mechanism for Environmental Resources Adjudication

19. Strengthen judicial interpretation and research on environmental resources. Closely combine the needs of judicial protection of environmental resources in China, strengthen research on the application of law and litigation systems for new issues in judicial protection of environmental resources, learn from useful international experience in judicial protection of environmental resources, and timely formulate judicial interpretations on legal issues concerning civil liability for environmental resources damage, environmental civil public interest litigation, mining rights, and other environmental resources disputes. Strengthen research on new topics such as disputes related to carbon emissions trading, emission rights trading, water rights trading, new energy development and utilization, and environmental services, and issue judicial interpretations or guiding opinions when conditions are ripe. Actively participate in environmental resources legislation, conduct in-depth research and promptly submit legislative proposals, and promote the continuous improvement of the environmental resources legal system.

20. Give full play to the role of experts in environmental resources adjudication. Establish a pool of experts in environmental resources adjudication; fully solicit expert opinions when adjudicating significant and difficult cases, discussing difficult professional issues, and formulating normative documents. Environmental resources experts may be engaged as special mediators, using their professional technical knowledge to prompt the parties to consciously recognize their mistakes, restore the environment, and compensate for losses. Protect the parties' right to request experts to appear in court to express opinions; for qualified applications, promptly notify the experts to appear in court to provide opinions on appraisal opinions and professional issues.

21. Strengthen coordination and linkage among functional departments for environmental resources protection. Strengthen the work interface between environmental resources adjudication organs and case filing, enforcement, and trial supervision organs, and strengthen information reporting and business exchange between higher and lower level courts. Fully utilize judicial suggestions to promote environmental law enforcement. Actively promote the establishment of an environmental resources law enforcement coordination mechanism among adjudication organs, procuratorial organs, public security organs, and administrative law enforcement departments for environmental resources protection. Strengthen communication with administrative law enforcement departments for environmental resources protection and judicial appraisal authorities, and promote the improvement of the mechanism for judicial appraisal of environmental resources and assessment of damage results.

VII. Increase Judicial Openness and Publicity of Environmental Resources

22. Increase public participation and judicial openness in environmental resources adjudication. Actively respond to the public's desire to participate in environmental resources protection, and fully implement the participation of people's assessors in the adjudication of environmental resources cases. Consciously accept public supervision, promote the establishment of a Chinese environmental resources judgment documents website, and promptly publish effective judgment documents online. For cases of significant impact, invite deputies to the National People's Congress, members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and the public to attend court hearings to enhance the openness and credibility of environmental resources adjudication.

23. Increase publicity of judicial protection of environmental resources. Fully utilize traditional media and new media such as WeChat, Weibo, and news client terminals, and publicize environmental resources protection laws and regulations through open trials, explaining laws with cases, issuing important news and typical cases on environmental resources justice, and raise public awareness of environmental resources protection. Regularly release the "White Paper on Environmental Resources Adjudication in China" to enhance the public's objective and comprehensive understanding of the judicial protection system and the status of protection of environmental resources.

VIII. Vigorously Strengthen the Building of the Environmental Resources Adjudication Team

24. Strengthen the ideological and political construction of the environmental resources adjudication team. In accordance with the standard of "five types of excellence" proposed by General Secretary Xi Jinping, combined with the policy and professional requirements of environmental resources adjudication work, strengthen the team's political awareness, overall awareness, mass awareness, national conditions awareness, and stability awareness, ensuring that environmental resources adjudication work serves the overall work of the Party and the state.

25. Strengthen the professional construction of the environmental resources adjudication team. In accordance with the requirements of professional adjudication of environmental resources, timely introduce talents and focus on cultivating talents. Increase training for the environmental resources adjudication team, learn professional knowledge of environmental resources, study difficult issues in adjudication, update judicial concepts, improve judicial ability, and strive to build a professional environmental resources adjudication team with strong political awareness, professional competence, and high quality.

26. Strengthen the leadership team of environmental resource trial institutions. Select the best and strengthen the leadership team of environmental resource trial institutions, enhance the team's ability to grasp the overall situation of environmental resource trial work and solve practical problems in environmental resource protection, improve the team's collective decision-making ability and overall synergy, and form a leadership core that is politically aware, mindful of the overall situation, cohesive, and combat-effective, thereby providing strong organizational leadership for comprehensively strengthening the environmental resource trial work of the people's courts.

June 23, 2014
